RAMAVATH VEERESH NAIK

Full-Stack Engineer | Backend-Focused | MERN

+91 7702513376 | veereshnaikdevloper@gmail.com | Hyderabad, India | LinkedIn | github

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Full-Stack Engineer with 3+ years building and scaling enterprise-grade backend systems and fintech platforms from architecture to production. Led a 12-engineer team scaling a live financial platform to 20,000+ active users processing 250,000+ daily system events (transactions, mining, rewards, payouts). Strong hands-on experience in Node.js, Apache Kafka, Redis, AWS, React.js, and distributed system design.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages & Frameworks: JavaScript (ES6+), Node.js, React.js, Next.js, Express.js, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap Databases & Caching: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Cloud Firestore Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, VPC, ALB, S3, CloudFront, SSM), Nginx, CI/CD Pipelines, Git, Zero-Downtime Deployments Message Brokers: Apache Kafka (DLQ, Retry Logic, Idempotency), BullMQ, Redis Queues Security & Auth: JWT, OAuth 2.0, AES Encryption, Private Key Management, OWASP Top 10, Rate Limiting Blockchain & Web3: Smart Contracts, Custodial Wallets, Token Swaps, Web3.js, MetaMask, TrustWallet, Binance BEP20 Payment Gateways: Razorpay, PhonePe, PayU — Automated Verification, OCR (Tesseract) Transaction Processing Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Promtail, Distributed Tracing, Application Logging Architecture: System Design, Event-Driven Systems, Horizontal & Vertical Scaling, SOLID Principles, ACID Compliance, REST APIs Leadership: Team Leadership (12 Engineers), Code Reviews, Technical Mentoring, Project Planning, Risk Assessment

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Apr 2025 – July 2026 Full-Stack Engineer | Jaisvik Software (P) Limited – Jaimax Decentralized Digital Currency ● Spearheaded a 12-engineer team owning end-to-end system design and AWS cloud infrastructure, scaling the platform to 20,000+ active

users.

Architected a high-reliability cryptocurrency platform processing 250,000+ daily system events (transactions, mining, rewards, payouts)

— spanning wallet transfers, token purchases, referral bonuses, and daily payouts across Razorpay, PhonePe, and PayU.

Integrated OCR-based automated payment verification across all three gateways — eliminating manual reconciliation and reducing

payment ops effort to near-zero.

Designed J-Wallet custodial wallet with AES-encrypted key storage and unified interface for token swaps and Binance BEP20 deposits —

enabling secure financial operations at scale.

Designed event-driven architecture using Apache Kafka with DLQ and retry logic — improving system reliability and reducing transaction

failure rate by 30%.

Scaled API performance through Redis caching, cutting database load by 40% and response times by 50% — supporting business growth

without added infrastructure cost.

Engineered highly available AWS infrastructure with load balancing, health checks, and zero-downtime deployments — ensuring reliable

access for all users across financial-grade operations.

Ensured regulatory compliance via DigiLocker KYC integration, reducing onboarding friction while meeting Indian identity verification

mandates.

Drove retention through a multi-tier referral system, token swap, and AdMob-powered Android monetization — directly contributing to

platform revenue.

Engineered JMC Mining System with a three-phase reliability model (Normal → Recovery → Resurrection) and dynamic slot scheduling

— reducing the risk of revenue loss during recovery cycles.

Implemented polyglot persistence strategy with PostgreSQL for ACID-compliant financial transactions and MongoDB for high-volume

variable-schema logs — supporting long-term data scalability.

Automated critical business operations via scheduled cron jobs for staking payouts, mining notifications, and DB maintenance —

reducing ops overhead and eliminating manual intervention.

Full-Stack Web Developer | Swio Corporate And ITES Private Limited ● Delivered 8+ production web applications — PWAs, event platforms, e-commerce, and exam portals — scaling to 10,000+ users with

Jun 2023 – Apr 2025

consistent reliability and on-time delivery.

● Engineered Hashpro Academy platform with integrated payments and exam management — reducing onboarding time by 35% and

improving business conversion rates.

Designed secure, scalable RESTful APIs with JWT auth, RBAC, and optimized queries — achieving 99.9% availability across multi-role

business workflows.

Improved scalability through Redis-based caching on high-traffic routes, cutting API latency by 45% and reducing infrastructure load

without added cost.

Architected and deployed CollegeCircle, a multi-panel community platform with Firebase serverless backend — handling job listings,

study materials, and admin analytics for growing user base.

Delivered e-commerce solutions on Shopify (Tones Fashion, Shushubabies) and custom platforms — integrating payment gateways,

inventory management, and responsive storefronts.

Apr 2023 – Jun 2023 Web Development Intern | Swio Corporate And ITES Private Limited ● Designed and shipped an internal form builder replacing a paid external tool — saving ~$50/month — while driving UI development and

implementing technical SEO best practices that improved page visibility and organic reach.

Collaborated closely with marketing and engineering teams on UI development and tech SEO initiatives — contributing across the full

stack from component-level UI to API integration while refining system design skills through structured code reviews.

KEY PROJECTS

Jaimax Decentralized Digital Currency Platform ↗ Live Link Node.js · React · MongoDB · PostgreSQL · Apache Kafka · AWS · Web3 · Custodial Wallet · Digilocker KYC · OCR · Payment Gateways End-to-end blockchain fintech platform with fiat-to-crypto conversion, AES-encrypted custodial wallet, multi-tier referral engine, token swap, Binance BEP20 integration, and JMC mining system. Scaled to 20,000+ users processing 250,000+ daily system events (transactions, mining, rewards, payouts) — Kafka DLQ (30% failure reduction), Redis caching (40% DB load cut), full KYC compliance.

Hashpro Academy Platform ↗ Live Link React.js · Node.js · Express.js · Payment Gateway · Exam Management Digital marketing academy with integrated payment gateway, exam management, and user administration for streamlined student onboarding and fee collection. Reduced onboarding time by 35%, maintained 99.9% API availability.

Raw Talks With VK ↗ Live Link React.js · Node.js · Firebase · Podcast Platform Podcast platform featuring in-depth conversations with Telugu community leaders — built for content delivery, episode management, and audience engagement with a scalable Firebase backend.

ADDITIONAL PROJECTS

Internal Portal – Hashpro Academy ↗ React · Node.js · MongoDB · Dashboard · Analytics Lead management and payment tracking system — improved conversion visibility, automated follow-ups, reduced manual ops effort.

CollegeCircle – College Community Platform ↗ React.js · Node.js · Firebase Cloud Functions · Firestore Freelance full-stack platform (collegecircle.cc) with admin/user panels, job postings, study materials, and analytics dashboard.

Bhookr – Cloud Kitchen Service ↗ React · Node.js · MongoDB · Payment Gateway · Subscription Subscription-based cloud kitchen with healthy meal delivery, live kitchen tracking, and integrated payments.

ANS Safety Nets ↗ React · Node.js · HTML5 · CSS3 Corporate website for a safety net installation company — services showcase, project gallery, and inquiry management.

Tones Fashion ↗ Shopify · E-Commerce · Payment Integration · Liquid Custom Shopify storefront for premium men's fashion — product listings, order management, and payment integration.

Shushubabies ↗ Shopify · E-Commerce · Payment Integration Shopify platform for baby skincare essentials — product management, cart, and payment integration.

EDUCATION & LANGUAGES

B.Tech | PVKK Institute of Technology | Aggregate: 86% | 2021 – 2024

Diploma | GMR Polytechnic, Srisailam | Aggregate: 84.98% | 2018 – 2021 Languages: English (Professional) · Telugu (Native) · Hindi (Conversational)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Apr 2025 – July 2026 Full-Stack Engineer | Jaisvik Software (P) Limited – Jaimax Decentralized Digital Currency ● Spearheaded a 12-engineer team owning end-to-end system design and AWS cloud infrastructure, scaling the platform to 20,000+ active
users.
Architected a high-reliability cryptocurrency platform processing 250,000+ daily system events (transactions, mining, rewards, payouts)
— spanning wallet transfers, token purchases, referral bonuses, and daily payouts across Razorpay, PhonePe, and PayU.
Integrated OCR-based automated payment verification across all three gateways — eliminating manual reconciliation and reducing
payment ops effort to near-zero.
Designed J-Wallet custodial wallet with AES-encrypted key storage and unified interface for token swaps and Binance BEP20 deposits —
enabling secure financial operations at scale.
Designed event-driven architecture using Apache Kafka with DLQ and retry logic — improving system reliability and reducing transaction
failure rate by 30%.
Scaled API performance through Redis caching, cutting database load by 40% and response times by 50% — supporting business growth
without added infrastructure cost.
Engineered highly available AWS infrastructure with load balancing, health checks, and zero-downtime deployments — ensuring reliable
access for all users across financial-grade operations.
Ensured regulatory compliance via DigiLocker KYC integration, reducing onboarding friction while meeting Indian identity verification
mandates.
Drove retention through a multi-tier referral system, token swap, and AdMob-powered Android monetization — directly contributing to
platform revenue.
Engineered JMC Mining System with a three-phase reliability model (Normal → Recovery → Resurrection) and dynamic slot scheduling
— reducing the risk of revenue loss during recovery cycles.
Implemented polyglot persistence strategy with PostgreSQL for ACID-compliant financial transactions and MongoDB for high-volume
variable-schema logs — supporting long-term data scalability.
Automated critical business operations via scheduled cron jobs for staking payouts, mining notifications, and DB maintenance —
reducing ops overhead and eliminating manual intervention.
Full-Stack Web Developer | Swio Corporate And ITES Private Limited ● Delivered 8+ production web applications — PWAs, event platforms, e-commerce, and exam portals — scaling to 10,000+ users with
Jun 2023 – Apr 2025
consistent reliability and on-time delivery.
● Engineered Hashpro Academy platform with integrated payments and exam management — reducing onboarding time by 35% and
improving business conversion rates.
Designed secure, scalable RESTful APIs with JWT auth, RBAC, and optimized queries — achieving 99.9% availability across multi-role
business workflows.
Improved scalability through Redis-based caching on high-traffic routes, cutting API latency by 45% and reducing infrastructure load
without added cost.
Architected and deployed CollegeCircle, a multi-panel community platform with Firebase serverless backend — handling job listings,
study materials, and admin analytics for growing user base.
Delivered e-commerce solutions on Shopify (Tones Fashion, Shushubabies) and custom platforms — integrating payment gateways,
inventory management, and responsive storefronts.
Apr 2023 – Jun 2023 Web Development Intern | Swio Corporate And ITES Private Limited ● Designed and shipped an internal form builder replacing a paid external tool — saving ~$50/month — while driving UI development and
implementing technical SEO best practices that improved page visibility and organic reach.
Collaborated closely with marketing and engineering teams on UI development and tech SEO initiatives — contributing across the full
stack from component-level UI to API integration while refining system design skills through structured code reviews.
